subject: Add an anamorphic lens flare from the primary light source in the scene: introduce a characteristic horizontal blue-cyan streak flare crossing the frame, add circular bokeh ghost reflections along the flare axis, apply a subtle overall frame bloom from the light source, add a slight diffraction starburst on any specular highlights. The flare should feel like a high-quality anamorphic prime lens such as Panavision C-Series or Cooke anamorphic — cinematic and optical, not digital or fake.
